sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 UNIQUE, "shop_name" TEXT NULL, "shop_phone" TEXT NULL, "shop_address" TEXT NULL, "invoice_footer" TEXT NULL, "locale_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ar', "digit_style" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'follow', "negative_stock_policy" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'warn', "app_lock_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("app_lock_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "biometric_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("biometric_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "onboarding_completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (singleton = 1), CHECK (shop_phone IS NULL OR (shop_phone GLOB '[+0-9]*' AND NOT (substr(shop_phone, 2) GLOB '*[^0-9]*') AND length(ltrim(shop_phone, '+')) BETWEEN 7 AND 15)), CHECK (locale_code IN ('ar', 'en')), CHECK (digit_style IN ('follow', 'arabic', 'latin')), CHECK (negative_stock_policy IN ('warn', 'block')), CHECK (onboarding_completed_at IS NULL OR (shop_name IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(shop_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 60)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "counters" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_type" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "next_value" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (next_value >= 1), CHECK (doc_type IN ('SALE', 'SALE_RETURN', 'PURCHASE', 'EXPENSE', 'CUSTOMER_RECEIPT', 'SUPPLIER_PAYMENT')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "search_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "search_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "sku" TEXT NULL, "unit_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_price_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "avg_cost_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "low_stock_threshold_milli" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (unit_type IN ('piece', 'kg', 'liter', 'meter')), CHECK (sale_price_piasters >= 0), CHECK (avg_cost_piasters >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "search_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "suppliers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "search_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "search_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sales_invoices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "customer_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "subtotal_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid_at_sale_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payment_method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash', "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "voided_at" INTEGER NULL, "void_reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (discount_piasters >= 0 AND discount_piasters <= subtotal_piasters), CHECK (total_piasters = subtotal_piasters - discount_piasters), CHECK (paid_at_sale_piasters >= 0 AND paid_at_sale_piasters <= total_piasters), CHECK (paid_at_sale_piasters = total_piasters OR customer_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK (payment_method IN ('cash', 'wallet', 'instapay', 'card')), CHECK ((voided_at IS NULL) = (void_reason IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sales_invoice_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales_invoices (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "line_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "product_name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_type_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_price_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "line_total_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "invoice_discount_share_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "line_cost_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("sales_invoice_id", "line_no"), CHECK (unit_type_snapshot IN ('piece', 'kg', 'liter', 'meter')), CHECK (qty_milli > 0), CHECK (unit_price_piasters >= 0), CHECK (discount_piasters >= 0 AND discount_piasters <= (qty_milli * unit_price_piasters + 500) / 1000));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_returns" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "sales_invoice_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales_invoices (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "customer_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "total_refund_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_cost_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "refund_paid_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payment_method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash', "reason" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (refund_paid_piasters >= 0 AND refund_paid_piasters <= total_refund_piasters), CHECK (refund_paid_piasters = total_refund_piasters OR customer_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK (payment_method IN ('cash', 'wallet', 'instapay', 'card')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_return_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_return_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sale_returns (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "sale_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sale_items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "qty_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_price_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "refund_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (qty_milli > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_invoices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "supplier_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "supplier_ref" TEXT NULL, "invoice_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "subtotal_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payment_method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash', "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "voided_at" INTEGER NULL, "void_reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (discount_piasters >= 0 AND discount_piasters <= subtotal_piasters), CHECK (total_piasters = subtotal_piasters - discount_piasters), CHECK (paid_piasters >= 0 AND paid_piasters <= total_piasters), CHECK (paid_piasters = total_piasters OR supplier_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK (payment_method IN ('cash', 'wallet', 'instapay', 'card')), CHECK ((voided_at IS NULL) = (void_reason IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "purchase_invoice_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES purchase_invoices (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "line_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "product_name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "line_total_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "invoice_discount_share_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "net_line_cost_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "avg_cost_before_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "avg_cost_after_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("purchase_invoice_id", "line_no"), CHECK (qty_milli > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "movement_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty_delta_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sale_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sale_items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "sale_return_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sale_return_items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "purchase_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES purchase_items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "reverses_movement_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES stock_movements (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "adjustment_reason" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (movement_type IN ('OPENING', 'PURCHASE', 'PURCHASE_VOID', 'SALE', 'SALE_RETURN', 'SALE_VOID', 'ADJUSTMENT')), CHECK (adjustment_reason IS NULL OR adjustment_reason IN ('damage', 'count', 'other')), CHECK (qty_delta_milli != 0), CHECK ((adjustment_reason IS NOT NULL) = (movement_type = 'ADJUSTMENT')), CHECK (CASE movement_type WHEN 'OPENING' THEN qty_delta_milli > 0 AND sale_item_id IS NULL AND sale_return_item_id IS NULL AND purchase_item_id IS NULL AND reverses_movement_id IS NULL WHEN 'PURCHASE' THEN qty_delta_milli > 0 AND purchase_item_id IS NOT NULL AND sale_item_id IS NULL AND sale_return_item_id IS NULL AND reverses_movement_id IS NULL WHEN 'PURCHASE_VOID' THEN qty_delta_milli < 0 AND purchase_item_id IS NOT NULL AND reverses_movement_id IS NOT NULL AND sale_item_id IS NULL AND sale_return_item_id IS NULL WHEN 'SALE' THEN qty_delta_milli < 0 AND sale_item_id IS NOT NULL AND sale_return_item_id IS NULL AND purchase_item_id IS NULL AND reverses_movement_id IS NULL WHEN 'SALE_RETURN' THEN qty_delta_milli > 0 AND sale_return_item_id IS NOT NULL AND sale_item_id IS NULL AND purchase_item_id IS NULL AND reverses_movement_id IS NULL WHEN 'SALE_VOID' THEN qty_delta_milli > 0 AND sale_item_id IS NOT NULL AND reverses_movement_id IS NOT NULL AND sale_return_item_id IS NULL AND purchase_item_id IS NULL WHEN 'ADJUSTMENT' THEN sale_item_id IS NULL AND sale_return_item_id IS NULL AND purchase_item_id IS NULL AND reverses_movement_id IS NULL ELSE 0 END));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_ledger" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "entry_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sales_invoice_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sales_invoices (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "sale_return_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sale_returns (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "receipt_number" INTEGER NULL, "payment_method" TEXT NULL, "reverses_entry_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES customer_ledger (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (entry_type IN ('OPENING_BALANCE', 'SALE', 'PAYMENT_RECEIVED', 'SALE_RETURN', 'REFUND_PAID', 'SALE_VOID', 'ADJUSTMENT', 'REVERSAL')), CHECK (payment_method IS NULL OR payment_method IN ('cash', 'wallet', 'instapay', 'card')), CHECK (amount_piasters != 0), CHECK ((entry_type IN ('PAYMENT_RECEIVED', 'REFUND_PAID')) = (payment_method IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplier_ledger" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "entry_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "purchase_invoice_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES purchase_invoices (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "payment_number" INTEGER NULL, "payment_method" TEXT NULL, "reverses_entry_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES supplier_ledger (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (entry_type IN ('OPENING_BALANCE', 'PURCHASE', 'PAYMENT_MADE', 'PURCHASE_VOID', 'ADJUSTMENT', 'REVERSAL')), CHECK (payment_method IS NULL OR payment_method IN ('cash', 'wallet', 'instapay', 'card')), CHECK (amount_piasters != 0), CHECK ((entry_type = 'PAYMENT_MADE') = (payment_method IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "expense_category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES expense_categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "amount_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "spent_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "voided_at" INTEGER NULL, "void_reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount_piasters > 0), CHECK ((voided_at IS NULL) = (void_reason IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payment_parts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sales_invoice_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sales_invoices (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "purchase_invoice_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES purchase_invoices (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "customer_ledger_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES customer_ledger (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "supplier_ledger_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES supplier_ledger (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "expense_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES expenses (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "part_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_piasters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "account_ref" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((sales_invoice_id IS NOT NULL) + (purchase_invoice_id IS NOT NULL) + (customer_ledger_id IS NOT NULL) + (supplier_ledger_id IS NOT NULL) + (expense_id IS NOT NULL) = 1), CHECK (amount_piasters > 0), CHECK (part_no BETWEEN 1 AND 3), CHECK (method IN ('cash', 'wallet', 'instapay', 'card')), CHECK (account_ref IS NULL OR (method IN ('wallet', 'instapay') AND length(account_ref) BETWEEN 1 AND 40)));
